current_example.title: Example: Expressing a Vector in Component Form

q-316790.name: Question 1
q-316790.worked_solution:
Our vector is shown in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14252323/assets/ecc6f3682d17eb4878e43a24ada2d6989d73f34d44ce2e3adcf9e6dc201761d2.png)

Remember that in general, if a point $R$ has coordinates $({r}_{x},{r}_{y}),$ then its position vector is given by

$$
\overset{\to }{OR}={r}_{x}i+{r}_{y}\,j.
$$

Here, the point $R$ has coordinates $(2,4),$ so its position vector is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{OR} & =2\,i+4\,j.\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

Our vector is shown in the diagram below.

Remember that in general, if a point R has coordinates (rx,ry), then its position vector is given by

OR→=rxi+ryj.

Here, the point R has coordinates (2,4), so its position vector is given by OR→=2i+4j.

q-275102.worked_solution:
Our vector is shown in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14252323/assets/e132f8e20ffb38c70ef435a560a584b25a6509486cc148636d873a9e0e94ea52.png)

Remember that in general, if a point $R$ has coordinates $({r}_{x},{r}_{y}),$ then its position vector is given by

$$
\overset{\to }{OR}={r}_{x}i+{r}_{y}\,j.
$$

Here, the point $R$ has coordinates $(-4,5),$ so its position vector is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{OR} & =(-4)\cdot i+5\cdot j \\  & =-4\,i+5\,j.\end{aligned}
$$

q-17993.name: Question 3
q-17993.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14252323/assets/a86e5e973e15230943beaa3f8afdeed139690ba4e5cf3fed4c35895e5f4bd2d4.png)

The point $W$ is shown in the picture above. Find the coordinates of the corresponding position vector.
q-17993.worked_solution:
For a point with coordinates $({a}_{x},{a}_{y}),$ the position vector is $⟨{a}_{x},{a}_{y}⟩.$

The point $W$ has coordinates $(1.5,-2.5),$ so the position vector is

$$
\overset{\to }{OW}=⟨1.5,-2.5⟩.
$$

q-17993.html:
Question 3
?

The point W is shown in the picture above. Find the coordinates of the corresponding position vector.

a
OW→=⟨1,2⟩
b
OW→=⟨−2.5,1.5⟩
c
OW→=⟨2.5,−1.5⟩
d
OW→=⟨−1,−2⟩
e
OW→=⟨1.5,−2.5⟩
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

For a point with coordinates (ax,ay), the position vector is ⟨ax,ay⟩.

The point W has coordinates (1.5,−2.5), so the position vector is OW→=⟨1.5,−2.5⟩.

q-70514.html:
Question 4
?

The point U is shown in the picture above. Find the coordinates of the corresponding position vector.

a
OU→=⟨3,2.5⟩
b
OU→=⟨3,2⟩
c
OU→=⟨−3,2⟩
d
OU→=⟨3,−2.5⟩
e
OU→=⟨2.5,3⟩
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

For a point with coordinates (ax,ay), the position vector is ⟨ax,ay⟩.

The point U has coordinates (3,2.5), so the position vector is OU→=⟨3,2.5⟩.
